item.title: 1671 reproducciones · 85 reacciones | The Navy is reportedly considering naming a new aircraft carrier that was supposed to be named after a Black World War II hero after President Trump. Doris Miller was 20 years old when he enlisted in the Navy, he famously manned an anti-aircraft gun during the attack on Pearl Harbor despite never being trained on how to use it. His great-niece says she hopes leaders "strongly consider the magnitude of what Uncle Doris did that day." Miller, who made the ultimate sacrifice when he was 24, was the first African American to be awarded the Navy Cross. | CBS News
